input.subject: Ryan, close 30% more deals with FollowUpFox CRM
input.bodyText:
Hi Ryan,

Noticed you're a top producer at Douglas Elliman - congrats on the momentum!

Quick question: how are you tracking your leads and follow-ups right now? Most agents we talk to are losing deals to slow response times.

FollowUpFox is the CRM built for real estate teams. Our clients see 30% more closed deals within 90 days by automating listing alerts, drip campaigns, and buyer nurture.

Can I grab 15 minutes this week to show you a demo? Here's my calendar link.

Best,
Tyler Brandt
Account Executive, FollowUpFox

Not interested? Unsubscribe here.
